title: Exceptions.
bodyText: Out-of-state prescriptions filled pursuant to section 328-17.6 shall be exempt from this part.
bodyHtml: §328-99  Exceptions.  Out-of-state prescriptions filled pursuant to section 328-17.6 shall be exempt from this part. [L 1980, c 187, pt of §1; am L 1987, c 283, §22; am L 1992, c 177, §2]
